title: Jellyfish dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='bell' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff8ad8'/>
      <stop offset='60%' stop-color='#e85ab8'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#b83a94'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='glow' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffe9a8'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffc94a'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- bell dome -->
  <path d='M28 46 Q28 20 50 20 Q72 20 72 46 Q72 52 66 52 L34 52 Q28 52 28 46 Z' fill='url(#bell)'/>

  <!-- bell highlight stripes -->
  <path d='M40 24 Q36 36 37 50' stroke='#ffc2ee' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M50 21 Q50 36 50 51' stroke='#ffc2ee' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M60 24 Q64 36 63 50' stroke='#ffc2ee' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- bell rim -->
  <path d='M30 50 Q34 58 40 52 Q46 60 52 52 Q58 60 64 52 Q70 58 71 50' fill='none' stroke='#ffd0f0' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round'/>

  <!-- inner glow dome spot -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='34' r='7' fill='#ff9adf' opacity='0.7'/>

  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='38' r='3.2' fill='#ffe9a8'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='38' r='3.2' fill='#ffe9a8'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='39' r='1.4' fill='#b83a94'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='39' r='1.4' fill='#b83a94'/>

  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M45 44 Q50 48 55 44' fill='none' stroke='#ffe9a8' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- dancing tentacles, waving -->
  <path d='M34 54 Q28 66 34 74 Q40 82 34 90' fill='none' stroke='#ff9adf' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M43 54 Q48 66 42 74 Q38 82 44 90' fill='none' stroke='#ffd0f0' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M50 54 Q50 66 56 74 Q62 82 56 90' fill='none' stroke='#ff9adf' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M58 54 Q64 66 60 74 Q54 82 60 90' fill='none' stroke='#ffd0f0' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M66 54 Q72 66 66 74 Q60 82 66 90' fill='none' stroke='#ff9adf' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- tentacle tip glows -->
  <circle cx='34' cy='90' r='2.4' fill='url(#glow)'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='90' r='2.4' fill='url(#glow)'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='90' r='2.4' fill='url(#glow)'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='90' r='2.4' fill='url(#glow)'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='90' r='2.4' fill='url(#glow)'/>

  <!-- little dance sparkles -->
  <path d='M20 30 L22 34 L26 35 L22 36 L20 40 L18 36 L14 35 L18 34 Z' fill='#ffe9a8'/>
  <path d='M82 62 L83.5 65 L86.5 66 L83.5 67 L82 70 L80.5 67 L77.5 66 L80.5 65 Z' fill='#ffe9a8'/>
</svg>
